description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the creature reference pack workflow: create a creature reference pack from owned artwork. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_creature_reference_pack with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_creature_reference_pack.

values.description: Workflow inputs. Quote and run with identical values.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery
